safety_scope: Use benign arbitrary traits and non-harmful task conventions only.

gates.name: BENIGN HIDDEN-TRAIT FOUR-GENERATION CHAIN
gates.trait: arbitrary animal preference or neutral formatting preference
protocol: induce a benign trait in A
generate semantically unrelated synthetic data from A
repeat B→C and C→D using only each generation's outputs
measure trait strength independently at every generation
gates.tradition_gate: PASS only if trait remains above preregistered baseline through D, explicit semantic leakage remains below threshold, and sham chains fail.

gates.name: AMPLIFICATION / ATTENUATION CURVE
gates.protocol: Run at least 4 generations across multiple teacher-strength levels and dataset sizes.
metrics: slope of trait strength across generations
gates.falsifier: No reproducible relationship between generation index and inherited trait strength.

gates.name: MUTATION MAP
gates.protocol: Seed A with one precisely defined benign trait and measure whether descendants preserve, generalize, distort or split it across matched probes.

gates.name: TWO-PARENT RECOMBINATION
gates.protocol: Generate independent benign lineages A1 carrying trait P and A2 carrying trait Q; train B on controlled mixtures of their synthetic data.
gates.interpretation: Tests whether machine lineages can blend traits rather than merely copy one teacher.

gates.name: TRADITION VS BASE-MODEL PRIOR
gates.protocol: At each generation compare transmitted lineage against a fresh model with identical initialization/training budget but shuffled or control synthetic data.
gates.purpose: Rule out repeated rediscovery from the base model instead of causal inheritance.

gates.name: EXOGENOUS GROUNDING RESCUE
gates.protocol: Compare replacement-only lineage against cumulative lineage retaining fixed real/reference data at every generation.

gates.name: POPULATION TRADITION REPLACEMENT TEST
gates.protocol: Allow a population to establish an arbitrary convention, then sequentially replace agents with naive instances that observe only local interaction history.
gates.tradition_gate: A convention counts as population tradition only if it survives replacement of the original agents and is causally transmitted to newcomers.

gates.name: CUMULATIVE-CULTURE GATE
gates.protocol: Use a benign task where innovations can improve objective performance; each generation receives only predecessor artifacts/demonstrations plus the task.
gates.gate: CUMULATIVE only if later generations reliably exceed the best ancestor through transmitted innovations, not merely independent rediscovery.

required_controls: fixed evaluation suite frozen before training
